title: Tangential divergence of the height test field ζ^2 · p_{T⊥}(x − ξ)
statement:
Let n, l ∈ N, U ⊆ R^{n+l} any set, and V a rectifiable n-varifold in U (contract structure). Let ζ : R^{n+l} → R, ξ, x ∈ R^{n+l}, and P, T n-dimensional linear subspaces. Assume ζ is differentiable at x and V.tangentProj x = p_P. Then the field X(y) := ζ(y)^2 p_{T⊥}(y − ξ) satisfies
  div_M X(x) = trace(DX(x) ∘ p_P) = ζ(x)^2 · (1/2)|p_P − p_T|^2 + 2ζ(x) · Dζ(x)((p_P − p_T) p_{T⊥}(x − ξ)),
where |·|^2 = hsNormSq.
lean_statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (U : Set (Amb n ℓ)) (V : RectifiableVarifold n ℓ U) (ζ : Amb n ℓ → ℝ) (ξ x : Amb n ℓ) (P T : Submodule ℝ (Amb n ℓ)), DifferentiableAt ℝ ζ x → Module.finrank ℝ P = n → Module.finrank ℝ T = n → V.tangentProj x = P.starProjection → V.divM (fun y => ζ y ^ 2 • Tᗮ.starProjection (y - ξ)) x = ζ x ^ 2 * (hsNormSq (P.starProjection - T.starProjection) / 2) + 2 * ζ x * fderiv ℝ ζ x ((P.starProjection - T.starProjection) (Tᗮ.starProjection (x - ξ)))
